title: GitHub Secure Open Source Fund
description: GitHub funds maintainers of open source projects with $10,000 per project, paid in tranches, plus a security program with a virtual interview for selected projects. Applications are accepted year-round and one application keeps a project eligible for all future sessions.
reward: $10,000 per project: $6,000 during the program, $2,000 at the 6-month check-in and $2,000 at the 12-month check-in

eligibility.note: an open source first project with demonstrated community traction and adoption
a clear open source license on the repo
maintainer lives in a region supported by GitHub Sponsors

setup: sign up for GitHub Sponsors if you have not
add a clear open source license to the repo
rules: Rolling: applications are open on a rolling basis and are considered for all program sessions.
For current maintainers of an open source project: individuals, or teams of up to 2 people per project.
You must be 18 or older, have an active GitHub profile, live in a region supported by GitHub Sponsors, and not be a GitHub employee or contractor.
The project needs a clear open source license, demonstrated community traction and adoption, and a clear governance structure before kick-off.
Core leaders must commit to the required programming and be willing to engage in and improve security.
Selected participants commit 15 hours over a 3-week period, plus 2.5 hours at each of the 6-month and 12-month check-ins; meetings are scheduled in Pacific time.
Funding is paid in tranches: $6,000 during the program, $2,000 at the 6-month check-in and $2,000 at the 12-month check-in.
Selected applicants have a virtual interview to determine next steps.
